description: Implementation of the MockPersistentNelStore class for network error logging policies, including command handling, policy management, and command verification.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore
classes.description: A mock class for simulating persistent storage of network error logging policies, supporting command queuing, loading, and verification.

classes.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Command
classes.description: Represents a command to modify or load policies in the mock store, with various constructors and comparison operators.

methods.name: Command::Command
methods.description: Constructor for creating a command with a specific type and optional callback or policy.

methods.name: operator==
methods.description: Equality operator to compare two commands based on type and key.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::LoadNelPolicies
methods.description: Queues a load policies command with a callback.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::Flush
methods.description: Queues a flush command and updates policy count.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::SetPrestoredPolicies
methods.description: Sets initial policies to the store.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::FinishLoading
methods.description: Simulates finishing the load process, invoking callbacks with policies.

methods.name: MockPersistentNelStore::VerifyCommands
methods.description: Verifies if the queued commands match expected commands.
